core_finding: Weights, labels and official encoder agree; original old text was placed wholly in the new-model future slot, left slot empty. The benchmark is not task matched.

vi_cycle75_training_exposure.interpretation: Upper bound only: draws include repetitions and earlier smaller corpora; this is not an epoch completion count.

data_quality_known_prose_issues.interpretation: Known recipe defects do not by themselves quantify or explain the entire old-dev gap.

statistical_fallacy_scan.Simpson: Do not pool different tasks/sources/label mixtures into one ranking.
statistical_fallacy_scan.Ecological: Do not infer human/audio quality from text-only derived labels.
statistical_fallacy_scan.Berkson: Old dev selected checkpoint/config/threshold for the small model.
statistical_fallacy_scan.Collider: Error examples and heuristic flags are exploratory, not representative label-noise estimates.
statistical_fallacy_scan.Base_rate: Old NEOT prevalence12220/17833; report F1 alongside accuracy.
statistical_fallacy_scan.Regression_to_mean: One fixedC75 checkpoint, no threshold/checkpoint search on this audit.
statistical_fallacy_scan.Survivorship: All17833 rows checked, none dropped to improve score.
statistical_fallacy_scan.Look_elsewhere: Heuristic grammar flags not significance tests or certified wrong labels.
statistical_fallacy_scan.Forking_paths: Prior raw report retained; no posthoc corrected score claimed.
statistical_fallacy_scan.Correlation_causation: No controlled data-volume or model-size ablation, so cannot attribute the gap to more data.
statistical_fallacy_scan.Reverse_causality: No causal direction claimed from this descriptive comparison.

next_valid_protocol: Use complete continuous source with observed left text and actual next1/2words for both EOT and NEOT, fixed weights/threshold and source-disjoint labels; do not invent future or move the evaluation boundary.
